questions.explanation: An antiderivative is $x^3/3$. Evaluating at the endpoints gives $1/3$.

questions.prompt: Differentiate $x^3$ using the power rule and show your substitution.

rubric.description: State the correct power rule (1 point) and identify $n=3$ (1 point).
Substitute to obtain $3x^{3-1}$ (1 point), simplify the exponent to $2$ (1 point), and state the final derivative $3x^2$ (1 point).

questions.prompt: What is the derivative of a constant function?
questions.explanation: A constant function has no change in value as its input changes.
